label: Discount rate
rationale: Nominal unlevered discount-rate scenarios; not a fitted WACC.

label: Appraisal multiplier
rationale: Scenario mark relative to dated appraisals, not a new broker appraisal.

label: Retirement age
rationale: Retire July 1 of build year plus age; build month is unavailable.

label: Unavailable share of owned days
rationale: Includes normalized docking downtime. H1 disclosed gap: 1199/24401.

label: Vessel operating cost
rationale: H1 vessel operating cost / ownership days is about $5168; management separate.

label: Management cost
rationale: H1 management fees / ownership days is about $454.

label: Corporate overhead
rationale: Cash G&A proxy annualizes H1 G&A less share compensation; stock dilution separately editable.

label: Drydock cash budget
rationale: Normalized annual cash budget, not individual docking dates. H1 expensed docking annualized is about $580k/vessel.

label: Other maintenance capex
rationale: Excludes drydock budget and newbuild delivery payments.

label: Net scrap proxy
rationale: Explicit DWT-based proxy, not lightweight tonnage times steel price; sensitivity only.

label: Annual cost and rate growth
rationale: Same nominal escalation on TCE, opex and recurring cash budgets; no perpetual terminal value.

label: Cash taxes / TCE revenue
rationale: Simplified cash-tax proxy; no jurisdictional tax model or interest tax shield.

label: Debt interest rate
rationale: Cash interest scenarios; H1 disclosed weighted rate was 5.3%.

label: Unreported net cash change
rationale: Net July 1–Oct 9 cash change excluding disclosed equity proceeds, dividends and debt repayment. Includes operating cash, vessel sales, delivery payments and restricted-cash release. Estimated, not a reported balance.

label: Remaining newbuild payment multiplier
rationale: Base allocation of June remaining commitments evenly across five hulls; three future hulls remain.

label: Other net claims
rationale: Net operating lease/other-claim valuation adjustment. Base charter-in activity assumed zero net value; book lease liability is not subtracted alone.

label: Overhead retained until last retirement
rationale: Fraction of overhead remains fixed while any fleet operates; rest declines with owned days.

label: Additional share dilution
rationale: Separate from completed September issuance; not weighted-average EPS shares.

label: Hypothetical additional ATM gross proceeds
rationale: Default undrawn. Both disclosed programs total $116.37111m; issuance adds cash net fees and shares at market price.

label: ATM fee assumption
rationale: Illustrative all-in issuance cost, not an observed completed transaction.

label: Fixed-charter share
rationale: Zero is an explicit open-fleet simplification, not a claim that actual fixed coverage is zero.

label: Fixed-charter TCE
rationale: Applied only to fixed-share assumption, which defaults to zero.

label: Operating working capital / annual TCE
rationale: Annualized net revenue working-capital target. Opening balance uses selected June operating assets less liabilities; release at fleet runoff.
